import_provenance.original_title: Constant-round concurrent zero knowledge from LWE alone
import_provenance.original_statement: Can LWE alone yield a constant-round zero-knowledge argument for every NP language in the plain model that remains secure under arbitrary polynomially many interleaved sessions, with polynomial-time simulation? This removes the bounded-player restriction from Goyal and coauthors’ constant-round protocols without assuming obfuscation.
import_provenance.supplied_caveat: Remark: Editorial minimal-assumption target: unrestricted constant-round concurrent zero knowledge already exists from stronger obfuscation assumptions. Results with superpolynomial-time simulation do not meet the stated requirement.
